اسلنطعا (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْطَعَا (islanṭaʕā) /is.lan.tˤa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
# اِسْلَنْطِعَا (islanṭiʕā) /is.lan.tˤi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْلَنْطَعَ (islanṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
